summary: Iteration 17 — Admin 2FA console (independent /admin/login, X-Admin-Token guard, members / topups / reports / translations / notifications). Backend: 24/24 passed in pytest (1 test skipped on 2nd run because its target expired topup was already credited by the 1st run, which itself passed). Frontend: all critical flows green after a one-line fix to the shared `Card` component in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/ui.jsx that was swallowing `data-testid` (so chart-* and notify-event-* didn't reach the DOM).

minor.issue: The row object is just `{**user_doc, ...}` so the `banned` field is missing for users whose doc never had the key written. Spec listed `banned` as a guaranteed column. Fix: `"banned": bool(u.get("banned") or False)` in admin_api.admin_members.

ui_bugs.issue: Card did not forward `data-testid` (and any other HTML attr) to its underlying div. Result: `chart-revenue_usd`, `chart-orders`, `chart-topup_usd`, `chart-new_users`, `notify-event-order_paid|order_completed|order_rejected|topup_paid` test-ids never reached the DOM, so automated tests and future RUM selectors would miss them. Fixed by spreading `...rest` on the Card div.

integration_issues.issue: Drawer only closes via backdrop click or the X button; there is no Escape-key handler. This can trap automation that uses `page.keyboard.press('Escape')` and is a minor UX gap for keyboard users.

issues: Even with .admin-light overrides, the markup still carries dark-mode classes (bg-slate-950/900/800) and only an `admin-light` class on the root flips them via !important CSS. Works for current screens (confirmed in screenshots: white sidebar, orange active nav, slate-700/900 text, white content cards) but any new section that uses primary brand colors or shadcn components will need the admin-light overrides updated. Consider refactoring Admin.jsx to directly use light-theme Tailwind classes once the look is finalised.

Transient console warnings `The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0` fire while the chart first mounts in a 0×0 container (ResponsiveContainer timing). Not blocking — charts settle to normal size after ~500ms. Could be silenced by setting `minHeight` on the chart Card or by lazy-mounting ResponsiveContainer after layout.

action_items: (minor) admin_api.admin_members: always emit `banned: bool` on each row — currently missing when the user doc never had the field set, which breaks the spec contract for the members listing.
(minor UX) Add Escape-key handler to MemberDetail drawer (MembersAdmin.jsx) for keyboard dismissal.
(polish) Silence recharts 0×0-container warnings by giving the chart card a `minHeight: 192px` style or deferring ResponsiveContainer mount.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_api.admin_topup_credit (L158): the credit path mutates status to 'pending' then calls `_usdt_settle`; the 409 is raised BEFORE the mutation on an already-paid record, so there's no window where a paid topup could be clobbered back to pending — good. However, _usdt_settle presumably increments the wallet; if it throws between the `set status=pending` and completion, the topup is left in a worse state than it started. Consider using a Mongo transaction, or at minimum roll back on exception.

admin_api._sign/_verify (L38-54): HS256 token using CLERK_SECRET_KEY as the HMAC key. Rotating the Clerk key invalidates every active admin session — acceptable but should be documented alongside the email-OTP HMAC usage noted in iteration 16.

admin_api.admin_member_detail (L209): computes balance_usd by fetching ALL wallet_transactions (`to_list(10000)`) just to sum them — same values are already computed server-side in the admin_members aggregation. Prefer a `$group` aggregate (one round-trip, O(1) memory) for consistency and scalability.

admin_api.admin_members (L189): `email: '' if email.endswith('@' + PHONE_DOMAIN)` strips phone-only sentinel emails but `banned`, `role`, etc. come from the raw doc spread — minor but inconsistent. Normalize all output fields in one pass.

Admin.jsx (L21-39): NAV table interleaves the brand-new sections (members/topups/reports/translations/notifications) between legacy ones, so the sidebar order is 總覽 → 商品/訂單/錢包/支付/認證/反饋/評價/匯率/優惠碼 → 會員/USDT充值單/數據報表/翻譯/通知 → 網站設定/頁尾Logo. For admin console IA, grouping the new 'core operations' at top or in a sub-section would improve findability.

admin/ui.jsx Card component (now fixed): any shared component that renders a wrapper div MUST forward unknown props (`...rest`), otherwise data-testid / aria-* / role props silently vanish. Add this review check to the component template.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_console.py. The credit test is self-skipping if run against an already-paid topup — to re-exercise the +balance assertion, pick a fresh pending/expired topup and update EXPIRED_TOPUP_ID. The sidebar is intentionally dark-markup + .admin-light CSS override — treat computed background rgb(255,255,255) as PASS even though raw className says bg-slate-900. Any new admin sub-page using the shared Card component now correctly forwards data-testid, so author new sections like `<Card data-testid="foo-section">`.
rca of the issue: Only one bug surfaced: admin/ui.jsx `Card` was destructuring just `{children, className}`, dropping every other prop including `data-testid`. ReportsAdmin & NotificationsAdmin set `data-testid` on Card instances (chart-* and notify-event-*), so those IDs were silently lost from the DOM. Fix: spread `...rest` onto the underlying div. Mitigation: add a lint rule or component template rule that every wrapper component forwards unknown props (or uses `React.forwardRef`). The admin members list `banned`-missing-field is likewise a one-line fix in admin_api.admin_members and does not affect the UI (frontend defaults it to false via `u.banned ? ... : ...`).
